background: Rabobank is a Dutch cooperative bank owned by its local member banks, the leading lender to Dutch agriculture and a large domestic mortgage lender, with a global food and agriculture franchise, funded by Dutch deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: The bank is rated AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratios are strong across the board against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 20.2%, leverage of 7.7%, LCR of 175% and NSFR of 130% are all in the top quarter, and CET1 has risen 4.3 points and leverage 0.8 points since 31 Mar 2024. The one flagged item, on 4 Aug 2026, is flat profit and provisioning for loan losses, an earnings matter rather than a solvency one. One of the strongest balance sheets among the large European banks.
